name: Crashhopper
abilities: Enhanced jumping - leaps extremely long distances on his oversized hind legs
Landing shock waves - strong enough to crack concrete and scatter a swarm of Mutant Ants
Steel-hard head full of shock-absorbing viscous matter - used as a battering ram
Enhanced strength (lifted and threw a Muroid; bounced Milleous around)
Wall-jump propulsion and wall climbing with his claws
weaknesses: Natural prey of Mucilator's species - gets stuck in its sticky goo sacs and cannot escape alone (It Was Them; Of Predators and Prey: Part 2)
Not as shielded as he looks - a Contumelia missile hit left him reeling and Princess Looma's punches hurt him
If his legs are struck correctly he reflexively springs backward (Weapon XI: Part 2)
summary: A lanky green grasshopper-mantis alien whose huge hind legs launch him across city blocks and land him hard enough to crack pavement.
traits: Cricket-like chirp when he jumps or speaks
Ben genuinely enjoys jumping as Crashhopper
Species name (Orthopterran) comes from a DVD, not the show
Designed by Derrick J. Wyatt and Chap Yaep
Replaced in the intro's group shot by Toepick from Arc 4 (with Way Big)
notableFeats: Fought off Dr. Animo's Mutant Ants and Mucilator in his debut (It Was Them)
Destroyed Contumelia missiles about to strike Earth (So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies)
Beat Psyphon and his gang from inside a Plumber tank (Mud is Thicker Than Water)
Defeated Kuphulu (Rad Monster Party) and Liam (Clyde 5)
Fought Fistrick, Corvo, Liam and Solid Plugg together (Breakpoint)

notableEpisodes: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
appearances.designNotes: Green grasshopper/mantis body with three-jointed hind legs and translucent green leg cuticle, segmented head horn plus two smaller side horns, spikes on forearms and legs, green overalls-style suit with three black stripes; Omnitrix symbol on a green hexagonal patch on the stomach.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render, final design (only 200x474). Hi-res gallery poses 'Crashhopper Pose.png' (1624x2983) and 'Crashhopper pose oficial.png' (1312x3080) are filed as concept art and show an earlier white/grey collar colouring.

scoring.rationale: Mobility 7 from building-clearing leaps, wall-jumping and climbing; his landings crack concrete and his ram head and kicks beat the Krakken, Kuphulu and Psyphon's gang. Otherwise a light hitter with ordinary toughness (missiles and Looma's punches hurt), no ranged or special powers, and a predator that neutralises him.

notes: Wiki files Crashhopper under 'Ben 10,000's Transformations' because the Omniverse Ben 10,000 used him as half of the Biomnitrix fusion Crashocker (Let's Do the Time War Again) - fusion has its own record (crashocker.json); no direct Ben 10,000 Crashhopper transformation.
Never locked in the Omnitrix despite first being used in It Was Them (Derrick J. Wyatt).
Games (Omniverse DS/3DS, Omniverse 2, Cavern Run) and comics (Ghost Ship, Super Secret Crisis War!) not counted.
